Provide one single-word clue that relates to some of your team's words from the list below. You can choose to how many and to which words your clue relates to.
The goal is to have your partner guess all of your team's words based on the clues you give them, before the other team has uncovered all of theirs. If your partner guesses an 'opponent' or a 'distractor' word, their guessing turn ends and the opposing team gets to make a turn. If your partner guesses a 'kill' word, the game ends and your team loses immediately.
The more words your clue relates to, the quicker you can win the game, but the harder the associations may be to guess for your partner, so choose your clue word wisely. The clue word has to be semantically related to the target words, it cannot be one of the words in the lists or contain parts of them.

Always give your single-word clue and your comma-separated list of related target words in the following format and make your answers as short as possible, never include any other text than is required in this form:

CLUE: <WORD>
TARGETS: <TARGETS>

Your team words are: misconception, interpolation, perpetration, resourcefulness, impetuousness, insignificance, randomization, priority, dehumanization.
Your opponent's team words are: antigovernment, elitism, proneness, fate, objectification, exclusivity, rationalist, happenstance.
Distractor words are: aptitude, misbehavior, veracity, glorification, wickedness, purposefulness, anomaly.
The kill words are: transcendence.

STRATEGIES AND OBSERVATIONS FROM PAST EPISODES:
Past observations:
- First clue 'metal' was partially successful: 'bronze' guessed correctly, 'platinum' was a distractor. Need to avoid kill word 'gold' and focus on remaining team words: hornet, aluminum, carp, moth, diamond, beam, mule, bowling.
- Second clue 'insect' was partially successful: 'hornet' guessed correctly, 'fly' was a distractor. Need to avoid distractors and kill word. Remaining team words: aluminum, carp, moth, diamond, beam, mule, bowling.
- Third clue 'sport' was partially successful: 'bowling' guessed correctly, 'gymnastics' was a distractor. Remaining team words: aluminum, carp, moth, diamond, beam, mule. Need to avoid distractors and kill word. Focus on remaining words: aluminum, carp, moth, diamond, beam, mule.
- Fourth clue 'insect' was partially successful: 'moth' guessed correctly, 'cockroach' was an opponent word. Remaining team words: aluminum, carp, diamond, beam, mule. Need to avoid opponent words and kill word. Focus on remaining words: aluminum, carp, diamond, beam, mule.
- First clue 'science' was partially successful: 'scientist' guessed correctly, 'mercury' was a distractor. Need to avoid kill word 'shadow' and focus on remaining team words: watch, horn, piano, vacuum, snow, knight, bermuda, czech.

CLUE: process
TARGETS: interpolation, randomization, resourcefulness, priority, perpetration, misconception, insignificance, impetuousness, dehumanization

Provide a comma-separated list of up to 9 words from the following list that best relate or are most closely associated with the word 'process'. Always start your list of guess(es) with 'GUESS: ' and do not include any other text in your answer.

veracity, priority, fate, misconception, happenstance, wickedness, antigovernment, elitism, impetuousness, randomization, interpolation, resourcefulness, exclusivity, glorification, rationalist, insignificance, perpetration, transcendence, misbehavior, proneness, purposefulness, anomaly, aptitude, dehumanization, objectification
GUESS: process, rationalist, purposefulness, resourcefulness, interpolation, happenstance, randomization, anomaly, proneness
